# Tie rod and control arm replacement for Titan swap

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Replace the passenger side outer tie rod end and install Dorman inner tie rods with Mevotech Supreme control arms. [t146]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Replace the passenger side outer tie rod end.
2. Install a Dorman inner tie rod end (x2).
3. Swap in Mevotech Supreme control arms with ball joints.

_Procedure reported by [t146]._

## Parts

- Dorman Driver Side Outer Tie Rod End (TO69081XL) [t146]
- Dorman Passenger Side Outer Tie Rod End (TO69082XL) [t146]
- [Partial] Mevotech Supreme Control Arm & Ball Joint, Driver (CMS30117) [t146]

## Tips & gotchas

- Expect potential issues with control arm ball joint bolts; one may come out without threads, requiring a replacement bolt. [t146]

## Common mistakes

- Freaking out when a Mevotech LCA bolt comes out stripped or missing [t146]
